notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.14
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! We're continuing to work on any bugs you all have found and will continue updating as needed. If you're still having some connection issues, please message [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198094136976?snr=1_5_9_]adambrosio[/url] on Steam or create a ticket in [url=https://discord.com/invite/ZhCggUYd85]Discord[/url].
We'd also love to know any content you would like to see in the game. You can let us know either here on the Steam discussion boards or in our [url=https://discord.com/invite/ZhCggUYd85]Discord[/url]! Now onto the patch notes!

[h3]Changes / Fixes:[/h3]
-Monsters drop a little more coins.
-Mission one fixed, ( Was not unlocking structure defence, or showing that it was completed.)
-can now place multiple Gates at once
-Removed ( -Check on the minor )

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.13
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! We're continuing to work on any bugs you all have found and will continue updating as needed. If you're still having some connection issues, please message [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198094136976]adambrosio [/url]on Steam or create a ticket in [url=https://discord.gg/ZhCggUYd85]Discord[/url]. 
We'd also love to know any content you would like to see in the game. You can let us know either here on the Steam discussion boards or in our [url=https://discord.gg/ZhCggUYd85]Discord[/url]! Now onto the patch notes!

Changes / Fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed Golem boss + Trickster boss achievements not registering
[*] The achievement "Make it to wave 100" is now "Make it to wave 70"
[*] Golem now has 10% less hp
[*] Added discord link button in the play screen
[*] Fixed memory leak
[*] Fixed the shop opening when not around the shop
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.12
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! We're continuing to work on any bugs you all have found and will continue updating as needed. Let us know any new issues that pop up for you, especially any connection issues as we believe these have mainly been fixed. 
We'd also love to know any content you would like to see in the game. You can let us know either here on the Steam discussion boards or in our [url=https://discord.gg/ZhCggUYd85]Discord[/url]! Now onto the patch notes!

[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Structure ammo not properly syncing on player join
[*] Tools and inventory now save when a player gets disconnected
[*] Structure previews now get destroyed when a player gets disconnected while building
[*] Structure previews now get destroyed when a player joins the game
[*] Healthbar for structure defense structure properly syncs when new player joins
[*] Fixed bug where going to lobby during a wave would prevent new players from joining
[*] Fixed bug where game would get stuck waiting for other players
[*] Disconnecting from a game now boots players to main menu instead of lobby town
[*] Localization issues fixed. 
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.11
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! We're continuing to work on any bugs you all have found and will continue updating as needed. Let us know any new issues that pop up for you, as well as let us know what other sort of content you would like to see in the game! You can let us know either here on the Steam discussion boards or in our [url=https://discord.gg/ZhCggUYd85]Discord[/url]! Now onto the patch notes!

[h3]Additions/Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where being poisoned while rolling would make a player impossible to revive
[*] Fixed coins incorrectly displaying at 999,999 in some cases
[*] Added the ability to join in the middle of an online game
[*] Fixed a bug where the crafting menu and inventory could only be navigated with arrow keys
[*] Fixed issue where a disconnected player wouldn't properly be booted from a game
[*] Reduced probability of disconnects
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.10
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!
We're continuing to add some of the suggestions that you all have been requesting since launch. [b]The main new feature is key binds![/b] You can now change the key binds to be whatever you would like for it to be. 
We are currently still working on getting the disconnection issues fixed. If you have any information that you think may be useful, please let us know either here on Steam or in our [url=https://discord.gg/ZhCggUYd85]Discord[/url].

[h3]Added[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added keybinds menu
[*] Game hints change to match key binds
[*] Added camera zoom setting in options menu
[*] Added 8 directions for building
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.9
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 
We're continuing to fix some of the bugs that we've seen reported from launch. [b]One main thing that we've fixed that a lot of you have been experiencing is the controller issues![/b] It took us a while to find the issues but we've finally got it fixed. Please let us know if you are still experiencing issues. You can report bugs either through the Discussion boards here on Steam or in our [url=https://discord.gg/ZhCggUYd85]Discord[/url]. 

[h3]Added/Fixed[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where fire crossbow was not shooting arrows
[*] Added splash screen for Freedom Games
[*] Changed fonts for Spanish, French, Portuguese
[*] Fixed Controller support
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.8
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 
Thank you all for an amazing launch so far. We have our first patch for you all today fixing some of the issues you all have been reporting. We are still actively working on finding solutions for some of the other issues which we have listed below. Hopefully this fixes some things for you all. If you haven't already, please consider leaving us a review. It really helps us out and we love getting to read everyone's feedback. 

Also we are working on getting key rebinding added into the game. This may take a little bit of time, but it is coming! 

[h3]Added/Fixed[/h3]
[list]
[*] credits added
[*] 2 spelling mistakes fixed
[*] mystery box should not show in mission mode only survival + protection
[*] boss tool bug (hammer and ace where doing only 2 dmg.)
[*] German translation fixed
[/list]
[h3]What we are looking into / need more info on: [/h3]
[i]If you are experiencing any of the following, please post a Discussion thread or join our [url=https://discord.gg/ZhCggUYd85]Discord [/url]and open a ticket so we can gather more info on it[/i]
[list]
[*] Connection issues
[*] Controller issues 
[/list]
